verdict.rationale: Activepieces is positioned as an open-source Zapier replacement with an embeddable flow builder. Flows are composed of a trigger followed by multiple actions, and a Publish button deploys your changes. Docs stress connecting 760+ apps 'without writing glue code.' Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the visual canvas and drag-and-drop editing experience (branching, loops, step configuration UI), and independent or hands-on corroboration that ops users build multi-step flows without code.
